AlertBot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] realtime-streaming p99 > 3s on /v1/stream (hosted-prod us-west) — paging Priya

Priya (oncall): acked, oncall here. pulling dashboards now. paging Samir + Elena.

Samir (eng-runtime): looking. grafana: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/stream/streaming-latency?orgId=1&from=now-10m — p95 ~800ms, p99 ~3.4s, tail shows spikes starting ~5m ago.

Elena (SRE): +1. I'm seeing increased retries and some streaming stalls reported by the runtime logs. No 500s, mainly head-of-line stalls and very long next-token times.

Priya (oncall): initial customer impact check — any 5xx or elevated error rates?

Samir (eng-runtime): no spike in 5xx. It looks like high per-token latency causing client-side timeouts in some SDKs. Quick check: run metrics curl:

```
curl -sS https://internal-metrics.redwood/api/metrics | grep stream_p99
# stream_p99 3.42
```

Samir (eng-runtime): hypothesis: kernel scheduling regression or sudden KV cache erosion for long-context sessions. Also saw a couple of kernel selection warnings earlier in logs.

Elena (SRE): checking node-level: GPU queue depth high on streaming-prod-usw-1 pool. kubectl events show several pods OOM-killed in last 15m (maybe due to a rollout?).

Priya (oncall): PagerDuty escalation?

PagerDuty: page sent to Priya; escalation window 5m.

Priya (oncall): I'm going to shift traffic off the problematic pool and roll restart the pool. Samir, can you prepare a rollback/route plan?

Samir (eng-runtime): yes. Plan: (1) mark streaming-prod-usw-1 as draining in router, (2) route traffic to streaming-prod-usw-2 (capacity headroom), (3) rollout restart streaming-prod-usw-1, collect kernel logs, (4) if p99 doesn't improve, enable fallback model redwood-stream-v1-small.

Elena (SRE): running drain now:
```
# mark nodes cordoned
kubectl label node streaming-prod-usw-1 node-role.kubernetes.io/drain=true
# scale up target pool briefly
kubectl scale deployment streaming-prod-usw-2 --replicas=12 -n inference
```

Samir (eng-runtime): applying router change to route 70% -> usw-2, 30% -> usw-1 for gradual move.

Priya (oncall): executing rollout restart on streaming-prod-usw-1 now:
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/streaming-prod-usw-1 -n inference
```

Samir (eng-runtime): while restart runs, quick config mitigation: lower max batching and enable prefix/KV cache warmup for active sessions. Priya, can you toggle those via Console?

Priya (oncall): toggling batch_size_max=8 and kv_cache_prefetch=true for model redwood-stream-v2 -> done. console change id: CFG-2027.

Kai (product): do we know which customers are impacted? any big accounts?

Samir (eng-runtime): checking traces. Affected sessions concentrated in customers using long-context streaming (seq_len > 2048). Top affected orgs: org_1287 (video-transcribe), org_3421 (live-chat), org_8899 (call-summaries). No obvious outage, but elevated latency causing client retries.

Elena (SRE): logs from a restarted pod show a pattern:
```
[2026-06-12T14:03:21Z] WARN kernel_select: fallback kernel used for attention, mismatch seq_len=4096
[2026-06-12T14:03:22Z] ERROR runtime: stall detected, kv-cache miss rate 42%
```

Samir (eng-runtime): that kv-cache miss rate spike aligns with the p99 jump. Could be cache eviction from a bad rollout or a memory regression.

Priya (oncall): Current metrics after routing + restart + config change — monitoring...

AlertBot: p99 dropped to 1.1s (from 3.4s) — observing for 2m before close. p95 steady ~600ms.

Elena (SRE): still seeing a few stalls but significantly reduced. Pod restart cleared kernel warnings on most nodes.

Priya (oncall): good. I'll keep traffic slowly migrating back once we confirm stability. Samir, can you capture kernel selection logs and dump KV-cache stats for postmortem?

Samir (eng-runtime): yes — pulling logs and stats, storing to s3://incidents/1745001234/kern-logs.tar.gz. KV-cache snapshot: pre-change miss_rate=41%, post-change miss_rate=7%.

Kai (product): summary for PMs: root cause candidate = sudden KV cache erosion after an automated rollout (likely changed memory footprints -> eviction) + longer sequences hitting fallback kernels. Mitigations applied: drain+restart pool, route traffic to backup pool, reduce batch_size, enable kv_cache_prefetch, temporary fallback model if needed.

Priya (oncall): PagerDuty: clear the immediate page, keep incident active for RCA.

PagerDuty: page cleared.

Priya (oncall): next actions: (1) Samir/Elena collect logs and attach to incident ticket, (2) SRE to schedule postmortem with rollout owners, (3) product to notify affected customers with context and mitigation steps if required. I'll create the incident ticket now and add owners.

Samir (eng-runtime): note — we should add an alert rule to detect kv-cache miss-rate spikes and correlate with p99 for streaming endpoints. Also tighten HPA thresholds so we avoid sudden node pressure.

Elena (SRE): I created a brief runbook note under incident ticket INC-1745001234 with the commands used and timeline.

Priya (oncall): thanks team. closing active mitigation window. keeping channel open for follow-up. :thumbsup:

AlertBot: :white_check_mark: Alert resolved — realtime-streaming p99 back under threshold.

Samir (eng-runtime): will follow up with a patch to the rollout job to prevent aggressive memory changes and a test to run long-seq synthetic workloads during canary.

Kai (product): schedule customer comms draft for legal review tomorrow.

Elena (SRE): postmortem owners: Samir (eng-runtime), Elena (SRE), Priya (oncall). ETA for postmortem: 48h.

Priya (oncall): incident thread archived to INC system. tagging for postmortem: #latency #kv-cache #streaming.

(End of thread)
